title: Health Fact-Checking Expertise
description: In 2020, I reached a significant milestone by becoming a certified Health Fact Checker. This certification reflects my dedication to ensuring accuracy not only in media and governance but also in the critical realm of health information.

title: National Speaker and Academic Recognition
description: Beyond my training role, I have gained national recognition as a speaker and academician. I have recently been invited to prestigious institutions like the National Academy of Audit and Accounts (NAAA) in Shimla, Lal Bahadur Shastri National Academy of Administration (LBSNAA) in Mussoorie, and the National Police Academy (NPA) in Hyderabad to deliver lectures on new media and governance.

title: Training Excellence at IIMC
description: Over my career I have trained Officer Trainees, senior armed forces personnel, government officials, and PSU executives at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). Specializing in new media, governance, and fact-checking, I served as the Course Director for Indian Information Service officers, both Group ‘A’ and Group ‘B,’ during my five-year tenure.
